name: Bounty Hunter Watts Bloods
description: The Bounty Hunter Watts Bloods are a Blood set based in the Nickerson Gardens public housing projects in Watts, the largest public housing development west of the Mississippi. Originally known as the Green Jackets, they were founded in 1969 by Gary Barker and Bobby Jack, growing into one of the largest African-American street gangs in Watts with an estimated 2,000 members. They are best known for their longstanding rivalry with the Grape Street Watts Crips, described as 'the most violent and long lasting feud between two gangs in the Watts area,' while maintaining an alliance with the PJ Watts Crips against that shared rival.
